news.title: Secret Twitch Drop Awarded Pouch of Violet Dust Toy to Live Stream Viewers in WoW: Forever
news.description: Players who watched the Legendary crafting stream on Twitch have been awarded a Pouch of Violet Dust Toy via Twitch Drops!
news.details:
If you watched the Legendary crafting stream earlier today, you may have been awarded a new Twitch drop. In the last few moments of the stream, when Taldramir, the Whispering Wood was revealed, players completed a Twitch Drop that awarded Pouch of Violet Dust! If you completed this, head to your Twitch drop and claim your prize!
It's unknown what the exact criteria was to obtain this Twitch Drop. Many players reported getting this item at the end of the Legendary Crafting stream, while others have reported getting it from any WoW streamer around the same time. In addition, the Drop Page has this listed with an End Date of Wednesday, November 4th at 1:59 PM PST / 4:59 PM EST. As this time has now passed, this seems to indicate that this Twitch Drop is no longer available and was only given to players who watched any WoW stream when the Legendary reveal went live. news.title: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood Revealed as WoW: Forever Legendary
news.description: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood has been revealed as WoW: Forever's new legendary!
news.details:
The build has been completed and as many had speculated, Blizzard was indeed teasing a Legendary!
While Blizzard didn't reveal any details on the class restrictions or its effects, this 2-Handed Legendary staff has a clear Druid theme. In addition, this weapon can be seen in the Skyborne Key art.

news.title: The Questie Addon is Back in WoW: Forever
news.description: If you played Classic in 2019 (and beyond), the Questie addon is likely a well-known name to you, and the addon is back in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
As we head into the launch of World of Warcraft: Forever, the thing that will occupy most of our time for the foreseeable future is leveling our characters out in the new and improved Azeroth!
Download Questie Addon on CurseForge
While some people may follow leveling guides, others want to completely avoid any type of outside help to experience the world anew, as close to "original" as possible. Some players, however, may find themselves somewhere in the middle of those two camps, and for those people we can highly recommend the addon Questie.
If you played Classic in 2019 (and beyond), the Questie addon is likely a well-known name to you, as the base game didn't have any type of quest indicators like the ones introduced in Wrath of the Lich King.
In Forever, the game, even without addons, has this type of feature, so Questie is more about some of the quality-of-life aspects that it…

news.title: Twitch Teasing "Major Reveal" on Warcraft Twitch Stream
news.description: Twitch is teasing a "major reveal" in an "exciting moment you don't want to miss" on the Warcraft Twitch Stream!
news.details:
Starting around 7:30 AM today, the Warcraft Twitch stream went live with no prior announcement. The only context that viewers receive is the Stream title, "Camelot_reveal v2_final.mp4" and the fact that the stream is building something.
Twitch has now released a blog highlighting the launch of WoW: Forever with a very interesting teaser at the end:
Be sure to check out a very special stream happening right now on /warcraft. Who knows, there may be an upcoming major reveal and a particularly exciting moment you don’t want to miss!

news.title: WoW: Forever Development Notes Updated - UI and Accessibility Updates
news.description: Blizzard has updated WoW: Forever Development notes before the official launch, adding new updates for UI and accessibility.
news.details:
We’ve added this section to the previous post.
User Interface and Accessibility
Swing Timer bar will no longer fade out due to distance until the swing finishes.
When combined bag is enabled, the background art of the inventory slots are updated to show which bag the slot is from.
Fixed an issue where Nameplates did not display Elite enemy status.
Debuff icons on the Nameplate can now be clicked through.
Spellbook and Talents frame now opens at the same height as other panels.
Combat mode for the Spellbook frame has been reduced in size.
PvP scoreboard display has been updated.
Killing a player while at Honor cap will no longer show honor gained in floating text or chat messages.
While in keybinds menu, hovering over an action bar keybind will now highlight the button on the action bar.

news.title: New Alliance and Horde Twitch Chat Badges for Subs to WoW Streamers
news.description: For the month of November, if you sub to a WoW streamer on Twitch, you can claim new Horde and Alliance chat badges!
news.details:
World of Warcraft: Forever launches today and if you're watching on Twitch, you can show off your Faction Pride with new chat badges. These are available until the end of the month on November 30th and require you to sub or gift a sub to a WoW streamer.
For the Horde or For the Alliance?
Wear your colours proudly with chat badges dropping today with the launch of WoW Forever.
Sub or gift to your favourite WoW streamer from today through midnight 11/30 to claim yours.

news.title: Introducing The Forever Files: Wowhead's Forever Newsletter
news.description: With the launch of WoW: Forever, Wowhead is launching another jam-packed newsletter - sign up for The Forever Files today!
news.details:
Forever is Here to Stay!
With the launch of Forever, Wowhead is launching another newsletter! Introducing The Forever Files, ready to bring you the latest stats, info, and more right in your inbox.
We've got even more exciting news about The Pandaren Post. Now that Forever is here, Classic is taking a broader lens - so we're revamping that newsletter into Classic Chronicles, focused on all things Classic (minus Forever).
Everyone has been buzzing about Forever, and we have been too! news.title: Did Blizzard Tease Future WoW: Forever Class and Race Combinations?
news.description: Blizzard recently released a Launch Overview for WoW: Forever - and there are some class and race combinations that caught players' eyes.
news.details:
Blizzard recently released a 30-minute Launch Overview video on the official World of Warcraft YouTube channel that gave a quick rundown of the new content and features coming in Forever, with an exclusive first look at some of the new dungeons and raid content.
However, people were quick to notice that some things were a bit off, as Chaos Bolts and other things that are not currently in the game were teased in certain shots.
That was not the only strange thing that was spotted. In several frames, a Druid could be seen using Starfall, an iconic ability from Wrath of the Lich King. Odd race combinations also made an appearance, like a Skyborne Paladin, a Tauren Mage casting Frostbolt, and a Night Elf rocking the Shaman tier 0.5 set.
Could these be teasers of what's to come or relics of things already far gone? It's likely the latter, but it serves as an interesting window into what the…
